messages.subject: var decl rules changed
parts:
I'm now disallowing constraints in variable
declarations inside of derived data and
derived parameters (and generated quantities)
blocks. That means range constraints for int
and double and also any of the subtypes of
vector, row_vector, or matrix (that is,
pos_ordered, simplex, corr_matrix, cov_matrix).

I changed the existing BUGS models that are
plugged into the unit tests. This was mainly
replacing

derived parameters {
double(0,) sigma;
...

with

derived parameters {
double sigma;
...

Other ones may need to be fixed in the same way before
they'll run.

I wanted to make it clear that these constraints
weren't being enforced anywhere -- you're on your
own with derived parameters and derived data
and generated quantities.

Feeding illegal values into distributions or
other functions still gets checked.

This does remove the constraint on writing
illegal derived parameters, which used to be
in place. But that constraint was illusory as
it didn't stop the constrained variable from
taking on illegal intermediate values before being
written.

- Bob
